seed_domain: u64; explicit seed resets episode ordinal to zero; implicit reset advances ordinal

support.bottled_cards: an owned Bottled relic names its bottled deck card (a purgeable card of the bottle's type; innate as native), or null for an owned bottle with no card
support.cards: the complete permanent union; upgrades as the Run's, Searing Blow up to 73 (damage within the engine's 3003 card base-damage surface); misc 0, Genetic Algorithm 1..=999, Ritual Dagger 15..=3003

deck.entry_generated: cards the entry generates (e.g. Mark of Pain's Wounds) count toward the engine's 999-card bound

position.boundary: the opening (first main) decision of the native start; an opening selection or offer is UnsupportedBoundary

enemies.hp: setup HP before the opening roll, 1..=the species' minimum max HP at the ascension
enemies.powers: setup values re-asserted at the opening decision (0 removes); every species: strength, vulnerable, weak, poison; the entry's declared burning buff (metallicize or regenerate) on every member with one amount; species-native artifact, thorns, strength_up, spore_cloud, plated_armor, metallicize
enemies.requires: a fixed formation with seed-independent species (not the shapes encounters)
enemies.slot: formation index (setup order), not the view's logical slot

position.label: synthetic_position: native-consistent synthetic state, never reachable gameplay
position.never: hidden state is never an input (draw order, seeds and random streams, intents, AI memory, card instances or handles, the turn number) and neither are relic counters, HP, max HP or items

piles.deck_rows: every entry deck card exactly once
piles.draw: unordered multiset shuffled by the gym
piles.generated: statuses (wound, dazed, burn, slimed, void) and the character's generated cards; opening-generated cards are discarded and de-issued
piles.hand: <= 10, left to right; innate/bottled deck cards required; not empty while Unceasing Top would draw; costs rolled as if drawn (Confused/Snecko on the session card stream)

player.orb_slots: 1..=10 with orbs (combats with orb slots); channel totals = listed orbs of each kind

support.potions: the character's complete potion union; the slot count is the ascension's base (3, or 2 from A11) plus 2 with Potion Belt
support.relics: the character's complete relic union plus Red Circlet, in acquisition order; counters in their domains
support.resource_semantics: already owned; acquisition effects are not repeated

start_kinds.fresh_start: owned resources and an encounter; no reachability claim
start_kinds.reachable_recipe: a Standard record prefix stopping at a combat decision (records map by SHA-256, each <= 8 MiB, total <= 64 MiB); hidden state re-sampled from its public root per reset
start_kinds.synthetic_position: plus a spire-gym-combat-position-v1 position at the opening decision; native-consistent synthetic state, never reachable gameplay

support.terminal: the combat's own terminal: victory +1 (all-enemies-escaped victory flagged), death -1, escaped 0; no settlement, rewards or Run-level settlement effects
support.unsupported: hidden state, draw order, seeds and RNG in any input; turn-N, mid-turn and selection-boundary positions; enemy intents and AI memory; original-runtime parity
